# rh remaining original proof source and historical body archive

1067 original bodies, 184 code files. Original remaining global, critical-line, finite arithmetic, scratch, computation and historical output bodies retain physical/arithmetic/cancellation stopping gates. B rerun log was found at a maintenance path with exact expected checksum; the earlier missing-bundle-path observation is preserved and corrected here. Numerical logs and symbolic/finite checkers are original unreviewed bodies, not fresh proof acceptance. Opaque arrays/containers and actual private operational material remain excluded.

This REVIEW checks archival scope and original byte preservation, not mathematical validity or fresh computational truth. Existing human/AI attribution and own original text/data CC BY4.0/code Apache2 grants apply; citations retain source rights. Exact source/public hashes, locator projections and historical status remain explicit. No research code, solver or proof checker was executed.
